text: じぶんのだす　わざが　「くさ」

structure.jp: じぶんのだす　わざが

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: じぶんのだす　わざ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. じぶんのだす　わざ = 'the move that you use'.

patterns.name: 〜の (subject)
patterns.explanation: Inside a short description placed before a thing, の can stand in for が and shows who does the action. じぶんのだす = 'that you yourself use'.
